rationale: Heon and Mooizz are both based in New York City and share complementary technical depth—Mooizz brings specialized expertise in LLM inference, computer vision, and robotics with a strong Python and C++ foundation from Adobe, while Heon has broad full-stack experience across JavaScript, Python, and Ruby as a CEO. As a judge and founder, Heon could offer valuable perspective on product strategy and fundraising, while Mooizz's domain expertise in emerging AI areas could be relevant to new ventures or technical evaluation.
intro_message: Heon, meet Mooizz Abdul—a software engineer at Adobe with deep expertise in LLM inference and computer vision, and fellow NYC-based technologist who could be a great sounding board for technical strategy.
